result.title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
result.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「选择性锚定」：在预训练扩散/流采样器外加一层约束，保护可靠测量到的图像成分不被生成先验改写，只让先验重建未解析结构，并把获取不确定性确定性或随机性地传入下游；另实现约束流模型 AnchoredFM，在稀疏视图 CT、加速 MRI 与光声断层上提升病灶对比度和不确定性可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 「不让先验抹去测量证据」以及把观测不确定性显式带到下游测试的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据被生成先验覆盖、关键细节在内部状态中坍缩的问题形成借鉴，其锚定与集成扰动机制可供核查。
